data: Apple's net sales rose from $383,285 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023) to $416,161 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025). That is an increase of $32,876 million, or about 8.6% over the two years. For context, fiscal 2024 net sales were $391,035 million, so growth was roughly 2.0% in fiscal 2024 and 6.4% in fiscal 2025.
